declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9PanRosserError_eq_active
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9PanRosserError_eq_active (B : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    currentChenUpsilon9PanRosserError B N cap z =
      ∑ d ∈ currentChenUpsilon9PanActive B N cap z,
        actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) d *
          currentChenUpsilon9PanError N d

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_abs_panError_le_MaxL
declarations.signature:
private theorem currentChenUpsilon9_abs_panError_le_MaxL {N d : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hNd : Nat.Coprime N d) :
    |currentChenUpsilon9PanError N d| ≤
      liuMainPanCoprimeIntervalMaxL (liuLogarithmicIntegral (2 / Real.log 2))
        N (currentChenUpsilon9PanLower N) (currentChenUpsilon9PanUpper N) d
        (currentChenUpsilon9ProductCoefficient N)

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_abs_panRosserError_le_MaxL_sum
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9_abs_panRosserError_le_MaxL_sum
    (B : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    |currentChenUpsilon9PanRosserError B N cap z| ≤
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (panModulusCutoff N B),
        liuMainPanCoprimeIntervalMaxL (liuLogarithmicIntegral (2 / Real.log 2))
          N (currentChenUpsilon9PanLower N) (currentChenUpsilon9PanUpper N) d
          (currentChenUpsilon9ProductCoefficient N)

declarations.name: exists_currentChenUpsilon9_panRosserError_budget
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_currentChenUpsilon9_panRosserError_budget :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ cap : ℕ, ∀ z : ℝ,
        |currentChenUpsilon9PanRosserError B N cap z| ≤
          ε * singularNormalization N

mathematical_findings.detail: ProductCoefficient is the zero-one membership function of the actual ninth selector product image, independent of d. Existing ordered-prime-factor injection and coefficient_sum preserve that same source coefficient on the AP mass, full li main mass, defect and Pan error without any pair/factorization multiplicity.

The pinned physical count searches prime q<=N with a*q<=N and a*q congruent to original N. Canonical residue N mod d is exactly the same congruence. Noncoprime a gives zero count only under explicit Coprime N d. The full li main mass is not falsely made coprime: the actual noncoprime li defect is retained and subtracted. This condition remains in the exact public decomposition.

Pan Ioc endpoints are ceil(N^(97/250))-1 and ceil(N^(309/500))-1. Ceiling-minus-one preserves the original closed lower and strict upper product band. The upper is strictly below N^(309/500)<=N^(2/3). Eventually lower power>=2 makes ceil(lower)-1>=lower/2; any fixed log(N)^(2B) is eventually below lower/2. No historical 9/19 scale or missing source-window condition is substituted.

Active actual upper Rosser weight at level cast(Q+1) has cast(d)<cast(Q+1), hence d<=Q. All omitted terms are exactly zero, even though they remain in the displayed divisor support. Actual support divisors are positive, so the active set is a subset of Icc 1 Q.

mathematical_findings.scope: signed aggregate and primitive residue maximum
mathematical_findings.detail: Triangle inequality uses the actual signed Rosser coefficient and its proved absolute bound one. Actual support gives Coprime d N. Positive d makes N mod d a genuine unit residue, including class zero for d=1. The maximum is applied to the entire same-coefficient coprime sum. Enlarging the active modulus subset uses the generic MaxL nonnegativity theorem, without a modulus-counting multiplier.

At U=3 the pinned provider chooses C,B,N0 before N, intervals and f. Final exists B>=0 precedes forall epsilon>0, eventually N, and then arbitrary cap,z. The eventual threshold depends on epsilon and chosen B; it is uniform in cap,z. The coefficient f_N may depend on N because the provider quantifies f after N.

Eventually log N>=1 and log N>=C/(epsilon*twinPrimeConstant) imply C/log N<=epsilon*twinPrimeConstant. Thus C*N/log^3<=epsilon*twinPrimeConstant*N/log^2<=epsilon*singularNormalization N. The actual all-N singularNormalization_lower has no suppressed parity or primality requirement.
